title: SENAI data management
subtitle: Upstream source registry, endpoint contract, mapping, sync and reconciliation — read-only source of truth

fnd007.lead: SENAI is the source of truth for factory identity, licences and industrial data. Inspection Platform reads and reconciles — it never writes back.
fnd007.holds: holds: the endpoint contract has no establishment master-data write-back.
fnd007.breach: breach: the endpoint contract now has a master-data write endpoint. Stop and escalate.
fnd007.snapshot: Observed-on-inspection snapshots are captured separately and never overwrite the source.

sources.help: Source data is read-only; this registry records which connections Inspection Platform uses. Setting it up is not the same as being connected.
sources.error: Source connections could not be read. Endpoint contract and recorded calls remain independently available.
sources.runsError: Recorded runs could not be read. Available connection settings are kept without a guessed freshness or counts.
sources.caption: Registered upstream source connections
sources.emptyBody: No source connection is registered. This is a checked, empty result, not a failure.
sources.footer: Record counts and freshness are shown only where a sync run recorded them. Nothing on this screen is estimated.
sources.footerUnavailable: Run freshness and counts are not available because the run source failed. Connection facts above remain readable.

endpoints.help: The documented read contract Inspection Platform is permitted to call. This is the same allow-list the runtime client enforces.
endpoints.callsError: Recorded live calls could not be read. The endpoint allow-list stays visible, but live-call verification is not available — not unverified.
endpoints.caption: SENAI endpoint contract and recorded call verification
endpoints.blocked: forwarding is turned off; nothing is sent
endpoints.noCall: No live call recorded. Documented is not connected.
endpoints.verificationUnavailable: Live-call history could not be read.
endpoints.footer: Verification comes only from recorded senaei_sync_calls rows. A non-success response shows the dependent Factory 360 section as honestly not available right now — never a made-up value. Endpoints outside this contract are refused by the client before any request leaves the server.

mapping.help: How SENAI fields map to internal fields, with transform and status.
mapping.heading: Field mapping registry
mapping.body: No field-mapping registry exists in the applied schema, so no mapping rule can be shown. You must not invent SENAI-to-internal field mappings, transforms or enum maps here: they change how source data is understood later. Until a mapping registry is approved and applied, the adapters in lib/integrations/senaei/adapters stay the only source for mapping, and unmapped fields show up later as not configured.

reconcile.runsError: Sync runs could not be read. Total row counts and freshness are not available; reconciliation divergences below remain independent.
reconcile.connectionsError: Source connections could not be read. The source-validation count is not available; recorded run and divergence facts are preserved.
reconcile.error: Reconciliation divergences could not be read. This is data that's not available, not a checked, empty divergence set.
reconcile.caption: Recorded reconciliation divergences
reconcile.emptyBody: No unresolved divergence is recorded. This is a checked, empty result.
reconcile.footer: Resolution is an approved reconciliation action, not an edit on this screen. Inspection Platform never silently overwrites a divergence in either direction, and never writes the resolution back to SENAI.
